canonical_model: In Chatterjee 0810.4221v2 Section 8, a path p has n vertices in Z^2_+, starts at (0,0), and takes right/up unit steps with final endpoint unrestricted on i+j=n-1. With independent standard Gaussian vertex weights g_v, X_p=sum_{v in p}g_v and M_n=max_p X_p. Distinct path sums tie with probability zero. Each path has variance n and Cov(X_p,X_q)=|p intersection q|. This is the zero-temperature Gaussian maximum; log Z at fixed finite inverse temperature is a different observable. Theorem 8.1 gives Var(M_n)<=C n/log n for n>=2. No current-openness conclusion is asserted.
exact_target: Find epsilon>0 and C,n0 independent of n such that Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon) for every n>=n0 in the cited Gaussian source model.
